title: Structural pest-control business and role-candidate review
hypothesis: A structural-pest business licence can establish a business identity and a named responsible applicator or operator candidate, but neither a licence role nor a published business number proves business ownership, handset ownership, a mobile line, or permission to contact a person. Agricultural crop-pest activity is outside this cohort.
ownerSource: Proposed TX TDA business-to-responsible-applicator join, CA CDPR business licence data, and FL FDACS company search. A certified operator, applicator, technician, or apprentice is a role candidate, never owner confirmation.
phoneSource: Only a future source field explicitly published for the licensed structural-pest business, or a matched Maps business number, may be business-contact evidence. No private-number discovery or employee-phone inference is in scope.

workflow.label: Structural-pest business fit?
workflow.detail: Require structural pest-control, exterminator, termite, or wildlife-removal evidence. Reject agricultural crop-pest activity; hold mosquito/lawn-only, sanitizing, insulation, and crawl-space-only results.

workflow.label: Hold non-structural or adjacent result
workflow.detail: Do not relabel crop/agricultural activity or adjacent-only service as structural pest control.

workflow.label: Independent business segment?
workflow.detail: Recognize franchise and multi-location pest brands before an owner hypothesis.

workflow.label: Hold franchise segment
workflow.detail: A local franchise listing can be a business contact but does not establish a local owner cell.

workflow.label: Eligible business-register route?
workflow.detail: Use a verified public business source only after its parser, role fields, source mapping, and terms are confirmed. Current TX, CA, and FL routes are not mapped for ingest.

workflow.label: Hold unavailable register route
workflow.detail: Do not substitute an employee applicator list, a paid crawler, or an invented register mapping.

workflow.label: Business and licence-role assessment
workflow.detail: Retain the licensed business separately from a responsible applicator/operator candidate. Technicians and apprentices are employee roles, not owner candidates.

workflow.label: Independent business-owner evidence?
workflow.detail: Licence title, company association, or a named applicator alone is insufficient; preserve role provenance.

workflow.label: Hold role-only candidate
workflow.detail: Do not label or deliver an employee, applicator, operator, or qualifier as owner-confirmed.

workflow.label: Published business contact present?
workflow.detail: A source or Maps phone is a business-contact candidate only and never a direct-owner assertion.

workflow.label: Hold absent or business-only contact
workflow.detail: Do not derive a personal contact from a licence role, address, or business record.

workflow.label: Contact and evidence gates
workflow.detail: Require applicable line-type, active/reachability, DNC/suppression, dedupe, independent owner, and handset-relationship evidence.

workflow.label: Hold failed evidence
workflow.detail: Park non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, shared, or unsupported-owner results.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Only an implemented future route with all contact and owner-evidence gates may deliver an owner-confirmed classification.

edges.label: crop, agricultural, adjacent-only, or no fit
all contact and owner gates pass

failures.risk: An employee applicator, technician, apprentice, or certified operator is labelled the business owner.
failures.mitigation: Persist exact licence role and business relationship; hold employee-class and role-only evidence until independent ownership evidence exists.

failures.risk: Agricultural crop-pest activity enters the structural-pest cohort because the profile accepts the generic term pest.
failures.mitigation: Add a pest-profile agricultural exclusion and fixtures before core acceptance; require explicit structural-pest evidence for mixed names.

failures.risk: A register or Maps business number is labelled a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Keep it business-contact evidence until line-type, reachability, DNC/suppression, dedupe, owner, and handset-evidence gates pass.

failures.risk: The described TX, CA, or FL licence route is assumed executable despite no adapter or register-source mapping.
failures.mitigation: Keep the register route unavailable until a source-specific adapter, verified fields, and an explicit register_source mapping exist.

failures.risk: A franchise or multi-location pest brand is treated as a local owner-operated shop.
failures.mitigation: Segment brands before owner inference and keep their published contact at business level.

sources.label: Live pest-control brain and relevance path
sources.scope: Recipe-C configuration, Maps fallback when no mapped register exists, and structural-pest relevance classification
sources.reference: src/data/lead-engine-brain.json industries.pest_control; src/lib/lead-engine-brain.ts registerSourceFor; src/lib/lead-engine-jobs.ts quoteJob; src/lib/lead-engine-industries.ts classifyRelevance

iterations.hypothesis: The existing pest profile keeps structural-pest businesses while excluding unrelated activity.
iterations.test: Five-case pure fixture/code audit of classifyRelevance(text, 'pest_control') on 2026-09-24.
iterations.observed: Pest Control and Wildlife Removal were core; Mosquito Lawn Treatments and Sanitizing Services were adjacent; Crop Pest Management was incorrectly core. No provider or contact data was queried.
iterations.change: Propose a pest-specific agricultural exclusion and explicit mixed-service fixture rule before any structural-pest contact workflow.

iterations.hypothesis: The live recipe-C pest route can read its named TX, CA, and FL public sources.
iterations.test: Code audit of route and registerSourceFor for TX, CA, FL, and NY.
iterations.observed: route reports the descriptive name_source for TX/CA/FL, but registerSourceFor returned null in each state. quoteJob requires a mapped register source and therefore chooses the Maps fallback; a recipe-C job would freeze if started without that fallback.
iterations.change: Do not claim a working register route. Add a source-specific adapter and mapping only after role/column validation.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: Crop/agricultural-only pest listings now fail relevance. Explicit residential/structural/termite/exterminator evidence preserves mixed businesses. Dedicated state pesticide-business adapters remain unimplemented.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five synthetic relevance cases: Pest Control core; Wildlife Removal core; Mosquito Lawn Treatments adjacent; Crop Pest Management incorrectly core; Sanitizing Services adjacent. Code audit only, with no provider calls or phone values retained. It does not measure source coverage, mobile status, reachability, DNC, handset ownership, owner confirmation, or delivery.

cost.basis: Fixture/code audit only; no provider or paid verification call
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. The pest_control brain's historical research estimate is a different denominator and is not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: Crop/agricultural-only pest listings now fail relevance. Explicit residential/structural/termite/exterminator evidence preserves mixed businesses. Dedicated state pesticide-business adapters remain unimplemented. Original review: The brain recognizes pest_control and the relevance path recognizes structural-pest vocabulary, but no TX/CA/FL pest register adapter or register_source mapping exists. Jobs therefore use the Maps fallback. The current core classifier also admits agricultural crop-pest activity.

nextMeasurement: After agricultural exclusion fixtures and a source-specific business-role parser exist, run a free aggregate field-coverage sample separately for licensed business rows and employee/applicator rows in TX, CA, and FL. Measure active structural-pest businesses, role distribution, business-contact-field fill, duplicate rates, and classifier holds. A later authorized outcome study must separately measure line type, DNC, reachability, independently confirmed ownership, and delivery.
